result.summary: Reworked src/design/iss0692_test_integration_capacity_mitigation.md to address all 5 issues from CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's FAIL verdict (3 MAJOR + 2 MINOR). Changes: (1) Added '## Module purpose' (one-paragraph goal statement) and '## Error taxonomy' (8-row table covering EnvUnset, EnvUnparseable, OptionOverridesEnv, JTooLow, JTooHigh, StmtTimeoutTooLow, StmtTimeoutUnparseable, LockReleaseLeftover) as second-level headings before the existing '## 1. Problem' section -- resolves E010x2 (lint_design_artefact.py now reports BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=0 on the file; the 6 remaining MINOR are E030 schema-qualified-name warnings inherited from the original design, not introduced by this rework). (2) Added '## 6.2 BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT=600s default anchor (full rationale)' with explicit citation of the ~65s cancellation clustering from docs/issues/ISS-0692.json description ('docker logs r-co-db_test-1 shows canceling statement due to statement timeout errors clustered at ~65s intervals'); argued 600s as the smallest power-of-two multiple above 5x65s=325s; argued WHY-NOT-900s (would mask real DDL regressions -- a 12-min index regression would silently bill wall-time rather than surface as a cancellation signal); argued WHY-NOT-450s (fails the margin check against 70s+ scheduling jitter and ~120s worst-case queue tail). Cross-referenced from the in-code comment at helpers.zig:139. (3) Added '## 9. Rollback plan' with 5 sub-sections: full revert via git revert (9.1), partial revert with knob-drop order (drop b first -- smaller blast radius -- then a) (9.1), observable signal triggers per failure-count band (0/1-2/3-4/5-of-5) (9.2), rollback verification procedure including the inverted 'must reproduce original failure mode' check (9.3), no-data-concerns confirmation -- both knobs are session-scoped, no DB migration reverts (9.4), and host-class escalation path beyond rollback (9.5). (4) MINOR: updated the illustrative 'After' block in §2.1 to use std.process.getEnvVar(b.allocator, 'BPM_TEST_INTEGRATION_JOB_CAP') (Zig 0.16 API) with inline comment documenting the API rename and how to verify with `zig version`. (5) MINOR: added '## 6.1 -j=8 default anchor (full rationale)' with the ISS-0665 prevention-note anchor (#cores/2 on 16-core host) and explicit WHY-NOT for -j4 (reproduces near failure threshold), -j16 (saturates host), -j32+ (above-N regression), -j12 (re-enters the 65s cancellation cluster). Cross-referenced from the in-code comment at the top of §2.1's 'After' block. The chosen mitigation (b)+(a), the env-var names, the chosen defaults (BPM_TEST_INTEGRATION_JOB_CAP, -j=8, BPM_TEST_STMT_TIMEOUT=600s), the no-touch list, and the verification plan are unchanged. Added §10 'Change history (rework summary)' documenting each fix. No source code touched. python3 tools/lint_design_artefact.py: BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=0 MINOR=6 (all 6 MINOR are pre-existing E030 schema-qualified-name warnings, not gate-blockers). python3 tools/lint_handoffs.py: 0 BLOCKER 0 MAJOR against this file (clean baseline; no new issues introduced).
